mechanics.name: Specialist
mechanics.currentEffect: Unlocking or rummaging through a Chest grants 1 Token, up to 6. A successful Great Repair Skill Check while repairing a Generator consumes all tokens and permanently reduces that Generator's required Repair Charges by 2/3/4 per token, up to 12/18/24 charges.
activation: Unlock or rummage through a Chest to gain tokens.
Hit a Great Repair Skill Check while repairing a Generator to spend them.
Ends/deactivates when: Tokens are consumed when a Great Repair Skill Check triggers the effect.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (8.1.0): Introduced; no later material live balance change located in the official notes checked.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Chest interactions bank tokens that a Great repair check spends to permanently reduce that Generator's repair requirement.
duration: The Generator charge reduction is permanent for that Generator for the Trial.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Gain 1 token per Chest unlocked or rummaged, capped at 6. A qualifying Great Repair Skill Check consumes all tokens.
specialInteractions: The consumed tokens reduce the charge requirement of the Generator being repaired when the Great check succeeds.

editorial.summary: Chest interactions grant Tokens that can be cashed on a Great generator Skill Check to permanently reduce that generator's required repair charges.
useCases: Convert chest time into permanent generator requirement reduction.
Use several Tokens at once on a difficult generator that the Killer keeps regressing.
Pair chest builds with objective pressure rather than treating looting as pure side activity.
counters: Requires unlocking or rummaging through Chests.
Needs a Great Skill Check to cash Tokens.
Chest-search time can outweigh the generator value if done inefficiently.
pros: Permanent objective reduction is difficult for the Killer to undo.
Adds objective purpose to chest builds.
cons: Great Skill Check requirement adds another failure point.
analysis: Specialist sits at this position because permanent repair-charge reduction is a meaningful reward attached to a costly economy. Each chest interaction can create Tokens, and a later Great Skill Check converts those Tokens into progress the Killer cannot simply regress away in the usual manner.

The perk is strongest when chest interactions already serve another purpose. Appraisal, Plunderer's Instinct, or a resource-focused build can make the setup less wasteful because the player receives items and Specialist Tokens from the same activity.

The danger is opportunity cost. Opening several chests to create objective progress can be slower than repairing a generator directly, especially if the chests are far apart or yield little item value.
That makes Specialist a niche but respectable objective perk. It can produce surprising permanent progress, but it asks the Survivor to build and route around it.
editorial.verdict: A permanent-progress perk with a chest tax. Specialist is strongest when looting is already part of the plan, not when you detour across the map just to manufacture Tokens.
